_doc: VALUE-FREE render skeleton. Keeps every structural label (headings, column headers, roles, units, formats, palette refs, slot wiring) but NO data: content="", rows=[], series=[], caption="". Pairs 1:1 with template.blueprint.json by shared IDs. The binder clones this, fills the slots from a dataset, and emits report.output.ast.json.
